svg.title: A New Rule Was Not Every Outcome
svg.desc: Policy: A decree can establish an intended institutional change.. Practice: Implementation needs evidence of actual people, resources and activities.. Experience: Access, attendance and learning are different questions.

g.text: A New Rule Was Not Every Outcome
A decree can establish an intended institutional change.
Implementation needs evidence of actual people, resources and
Access, attendance and learning are different questions.
What changed? What continued? What supports the claim?
